result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues where content is cut off or partially obscured, affecting user ability to see complete restaurant information.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the rightmost restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right edge of the screen, making it difficult to see the complete card and potentially the restaurant name
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel or grid layout has proper padding/margins so all cards are fully visible, or implement proper horizontal scrolling with visible scroll indicator

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the second restaurant card at the bottom is cut off - only the food image is visible with no restaurant name, rating, or delivery details shown
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout to ensure all restaurant cards in the 'Popular right now' section are fully visible above the bottom navigation bar, or use proper scrolling within a container
